quantization_method.coordinate_bound: Pair half-ULP normal estimate reuses 931 formula from per-coordinate Float32 spacing on both captured triangles. This is a coordinate representation diagnostic, not a bound on shader deformation, registration, or full rigid-fit residual.
quantization_method.native_normal: source normal rotated by accepted body index 20 quaternion from the step-10000 receipt.
quantization_method.nonqualification: Every exact native unallowed pair remains an unallowed event regardless of source-side relation or ULP ratio.
quantization_method.side_classifier: positive iff source min >= -1e-14m and max > 1e-14m; negative iff max <= 1e-14m and min < -1e-14m; otherwise ambiguous. Sensitivity across 0,1e-15,1e-14,1e-13,1e-12 m is retained.
quantization_method.signed_range: Projected triangle-footprint overlap: owner-B axial range minus owner-A axial position along source-derived normal. If projected area is empty, use closest-pair signed axial gap and record fallback.
quantization_method.source_normal: owner A source winding if source-coordinate keys share; otherwise source closest-point vector A to B. This sets a local pair direction, not anatomical outward.

scope: All 201 unallowed exact cross pairs from the complete 931 accepted N=10000 terminal full-row scan, plus all 25 unallowed row310 Pleura self pairs. No pair is reclassified as allowed; the source-side/quantization analysis is diagnostic only.
